programme.title: PWA World Cup - Tiberias, Israel
programme.desc: Athletes are meeting in Tiberias, Israel, for the PWA World Cup. This first leg of this year's competition will be filled with action after 18 months of inactivity. With winds between 18 and 30 knots, it will truly be a challenge for the world's best windsurf sailors and with this uncertainty in the conditions, we can expect anything to happen in Israel. Don't miss out on the PWA World Cup 2021 in Tiberias that marks the beginning of this year's windsurfing action!

programme.title: Inside Sailing - Episode 10
programme.desc: On this ocassion we travel to the Swiss Alps, concretely to the Engadin Valley. The upper part of the valley, at around 1800m is a magical place for tourism and both winter and summer sports. Vanora ENGADINWIND by Dakine, is one of the most famous watersports events in the world: a unique windsurfing festival that includes freestyle action.Then, we will head to Italy’s Genoa in order to focus on L30 class following the 2020 EUROSAF Mixed Offshore European Championships. Some of the continent’s best sailors put in their best performances in a bid for the title and we were there to capture all of the action.

programme.title: 52 Super Series - Ep.2 - Rolex TP52 World Championship Porto Cervo 2026
Atlantic Cup - Episode 3
programme.desc: Welcome back to this edition of the Atlantic Cup. It is time for the third and final leg of the competition, the inshore series. Dragon and Gryphon Solo 2 are tied for, and teams have added 4 extra crew, allowing them to push their boats around the tight courses in Naragannset Bay. Any mistake could be the difference between first and last. Who will become the winner in this edition?

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez - 20 Years Of Les Voiles De St Tropez
programme.desc: Join Nautical Channel for a full coverage of one of the most awaited nautical events in the world. We will bring you to the most exclusive events and have special insights with the best athletes and all the VIPs. We will show you what it feels like to be on board on an ultra-modern super yacht during a match race in the legendary bay of Brigitte Bardot and also take a look around inside some of the most amazing classic yachts that ever sailed.

programme.title: Yoga Is Sanctuary
programme.desc: Today’s lesson is about sanctuary and how to find a place of calm and peace deep within yourself. We’ll use the backbend Ustrasana, or Camel Pose, to dive into that inner world. Kino will guide you through warm ups and then a series of backbends that will challenge you. The idea is to work outside of your comfort zone, just a little, so you seek a source of strength from deep within. As you embrace the challenge you can also embrace a sense of sanctuary and connect to an inner space of faith and grace.

Use triangle pose as an opportunity to be present with and accepting towards whatever arises in the body and mind as you practice.

programme.title: Yoga Nidra for Healing

programme.title: Bakasana
programme.desc: A gentle flow that incorporates the fundamentals of yoga and builds up to the arm balance Bakasana, the crane pose.

programme.title: Handstands
programme.desc: Join Kino for 20 minutes of Handstand drills! Not recommended for beginners, this class does require a certain level of pre-established strength and flexibility. Work through these drills every week to take your handstand practice to the next level

programme.title: Kino in Bali
programme.desc: Come with Kino as she explores magical Bali in the latest installment of Global Yogi. This place is a mecca for yoga, healing, surfing and is known for its welcoming and peaceful Balinese culture. Here it’s common to discover a feeling of being safe and sound, and that was certainly the case for Kino. Green juice, island sand, coconuts and temples… the intoxicating energy of the island spirit can be found around every corner. Days are easily spent relaxing and and enjoying waves and sunsets. Check in for a massage, roll out your mat for practice, chat with the charming locals and find the perfect spot for a quiet meditation… All this and more as Kino continues to bring her message of insight and transformation to the world.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: This practice takes you on a journey through the fundamentals of yoga and culminates in a gentle backbend, the bridge pose

programme.title: Kino in Seattle
programme.desc: I don’t think we’re in Florida anymore! Follow along with Kino during her trip to Seattle, Washington as she adjusts to the colder weather, sets off in search of a hot cup of chai, tours historic areas like the Gas Works Park, supports local businesses, and shares the Ashtanga Yoga method with a group of excited yogis at the Yoga Lab Northwest.

programme.title: Jackfruit Green Enchiladas with Cashew Crema v2
Virabhadrasana A
programme.desc: This short class guides you towards increased awareness of the breath and body before flowing into a gentle asana sequence. The practice will use props to support the practice and will focus on the fundamental asana, Warrior One.

programme.title: Yoga Is Breath
programme.desc: Tune into the truth of who you are underneath the thoughts, using the breath and practice as a means of transformation into true self. This class uses chair pose to explore both physical embodiment and to fuel our inner journey into yoga. Join us for a practice that will bring awareness into your hips and legs, using props to support the postures where needed. Let Kino guide you into a stronger awareness of Agni, the inner fire that burns through impurities and helps the mind see clearer.

programme.title: Shalabhasana
programme.desc: A flow that thoroughly warms up the spine and builds up to the laying backbend called Shalabhasana.

programme.title: Tree Pose
programme.desc: A practice that builds up to tree pose. Get rooted into the fundamentals of yoga practice including breath and balance.

programme.title: Pigeon
programme.desc: Come explore supported hip opening with Kino. This class incorporates yoga fundamentals and builds up to Pigeon Pose.

programme.title: Leaning into Forward Folds
programme.desc: This session is all about sitting with the hamstrings and forward bends in a state of equanimity. Join Kino as she leads you on a journey to healing. Learn to sit with your discomfort and begin to uncover and understand the intelligent messages that come from within. 25 minutes

programme.title: Paschimottanasana
programme.desc: Begin with awareness of breath and body sensation in this gentle yoga class. You will find yourself present and relaxed by the end of this forward folding focused sequence.

programme.title: Twist - The Heart - Feel
programme.desc: The final class in this series is all about feeling into and entering the heart space through the vehicle of twists. The unfelt body is a reservoir of the unlived life. Unlock your potential for healing by connecting with these deep inner spaces of the body and just feeling.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Meditation for Kapha
programme.desc: As you’ve learned, Ayurveda recommends different yoga and meditation practices for each of the doshas. In this episode, Sahara Rose will guide you through a meditation that’s designed specifically for Kapha type people.

programme.title: Meditation Now - Release Judgment
programme.desc: Join Kino for a seaside meditation along the shores of the beautiful, Tulum, Mexico. Quite the mind and release all judgement so you can rest in the blissful awareness of all that is.

programme.title: Meditation Now - The Breath
programme.desc: Join Kino for a gentle meditation on the beach by the beautiful shores of Tulum, Mexico. Let go of your thoughts, and experiences as you use the breath to anchor you to the present moment.

programme.title: Morning Routine
programme.desc: One of Mark’s favorite morning routines, this is a slow-moving practice featuring static holds.

programme.title: Yoga Is Kindness
programme.desc: Invite kindness into your body, using Marichasana A as a framework for integrating tenderness into your practice. Let Kino guide you through a series of mindful, preparatory postures that bring awareness into the legs, hips and shoulders. This increased awareness will aid you as you move into the forward fold that today's practice revolves around. Use props where needed so that you can cultivate a kind and friendly attitude towards your body.

programme.title: Yoga Is Acceptance
programme.desc: Venture deep into the realm of body and mind in this sequence focused on an experience of santosha, the yogic notion of contentment. Join Kino as she skillfully uses upward facing dog as a tool for understanding this radical acceptance. Start with a short meditation on the breath and a feeling of being ok with the sensations in the body. Then begin the physical practice by awakening the central axis of the spine, extending and twisting your way through some warm up positions. Detail your alignment in the updog backbend with nuanced alignment work, making use of blocks where needed.

programme.title: Love Your Body
programme.desc: Come back into alignment through awareness of the body. Use the breath as an anchor to cultivate present moment awareness. Redirect the attention from the external world to the inner world, beginning with the sensation of breath along the inside of the nostrils. Learn to feel what is rather than generating a story. Allow yourself to feel safe and loved through the practice of mindfulness.

programme.title: Yoga Is Compassion
programme.desc: This class is centered around a quality that is perhaps the very essence of being a yogi: Compassion. We’ll use the posture Shalabhasana, which is a heart opening backbend, to help you find that compassionate center within yourself. Begin with a moment of loving kindness meditation followed by some physical warm up focused on spinal extension. Follow Kino through a series of backbends that will be a little challenging, but also connect you to the breath and the space around the heart.

programme.title: Vegan for Life with Devyn Howard
programme.desc: This episode of Seek Up is all about food!

programme.title: Boredom in Yoga
programme.desc: Join kino for a conversation about boredom in the yoga practice, what it means, and what you can do about it.

programme.title: Meet Alexa
programme.desc: Alexa Soto turned her passion for cooking into a way of life.

programme.title: BBQ Cauliﬂower Ranch Salad
programme.desc: This super simple salad is easy to make and perfect to take with you on the go.

programme.title: Opening the Hips
programme.desc: Join Kino for some yoga drills that will help you work on opening the hips with some external hip rotation. With this video, you will gain a greater understanding of the movement mechanics involved in the action of external hip rotation. Build strength in all the muscles that are involved in opening the hips through this 40-minute practice.

programme.title: One Hour Yoga Drills - Miami Heat Fire Session
programme.desc: Feel the heat in this yoga drills class. Kino will guide you through a well-rounded practice, including twists, backbends, core work, and shoulder work. Strengthen your back muscles in bow, bridge, and wheel poses. Explore three-legged dog drills to build core and shoulder strength.

programme.title: Yoga Is Spirit
programme.desc: Today's lesson is on Spirit and how to tune into that space beyond the physical. The vehicle for this deep awareness will be the shoulder stand, Halasana. This class will take you mindfully through warmups and then into several accessible variations of today's inversion practice. You will be invited to drop deeper down into a space of peace as Kino encourages you to tune deeply into the subtle vibrations of the inner body.

programme.title: Purvottanasana
programme.desc: Cultivate a mindful state as you prepare for practice, feeling into the breath and body. Flow through a prop supported sequence that builds up to Purvottanasana.

programme.title: Invert - Awaken
programme.desc: Join Kino for a class that’s all about inversions and the mindset of awakening. This 30-minute practice invites you to seize the opportunity to remain present and awake in the challenge of the practice. Begin the journey of turning yourself upside down to awaken the sleeper within.

programme.title: How to Become a Rich Yogi - True wealth story
programme.desc: In this last video, Rob shares a story that will help remind you of everything you’ve learned through this course. This story offers up one more practice that you can apply to your life to truly become a rich yogi.

programme.title: Backbend - Listen
programme.desc: Join Kino for as class that’s all about backbends and the journey of listening. Begin to tap into the subtle body as you move through this mindful, 25-minute backbending practice. Talk to your muscles and joints and listen to them as you find the strength and flexibility to move through this practice, all while bringing your awareness to various places in the body.

programme.title: Baddha Konasana
programme.desc: Feel the depth and power of the breath in this class that builds up to the hip opening posture Baddha Konasana.

programme.title: Bakasana
programme.desc: A gentle flow that incorporates the fundamentals of yoga and builds up to the arm balance Bakasana, the crane pose.

programme.title: Breathe - Freedom
programme.desc: In the 40-minute practice, Kino leads you through a journey with the breath. Move into the inner space of the body by reconnecting with the power and the vehicle of the breath. Discover the child-like innocence of your body as you engage in this breath focused practice with awareness and intention.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: This practice takes you on a journey through the fundamentals of yoga and culminates in a gentle backbend, the bridge pose

programme.title: Downward Facing Dog
programme.desc: Dive into the fundamentals of yoga with this sequence that builds up to downward facing dog.

programme.title: Emotions
programme.desc: Welcome to Meditations for Manifesting, how to bring yourself back into alignment with the greater good and pray from a place of wholeness and true faith. Episode one is all about the emotions. Begin with breath awareness, establishing a calm and steady mind. Cultivate a judgment free attitude as you explore the inner world of your thoughts and feelings.

programme.title: Everyday Drill
programme.desc: When it comes to building strength and flexibility for a more well-rounded yoga practice, yoga drills can help you expedite the process! Join Kino for a set of yoga drills that offer a little mix of everything. Stretch out and strengthen the core, legs, arms, shoulders, and everything in between. Just over 20 minutes.

programme.title: Freedom and Peace
programme.desc: This meditation for manifestation begins with a few moments of intentional presence. Begin by noticing the feeling of the breath and let this be your gateway to practice. You will also develop an awareness of sensations in the body and the movements of the mind. Kino will guide you into the sense of freedom that can arise from the watching of consciousness that is the act of mindfulness. Planting seeds of peace amidst a stream of anxiety and stress is the heart of today's practice.

programme.title: Gratitude
programme.desc: This meditation for manifestation will bring gratitude into your life. Settle the attention on the breath as you drop below the frequency of thought and into a more receptive state. Open up to the field of arising sensation and connect a sense of gratitude for the body as a tool in your mindfulness practice. Cultivate awareness of your inner experience, moving away from loops of thoughts and into a state of equanimity, alignment, deep peace and gratitude.

programme.title: Halasana
programme.desc: This class establishes a connection to breath, body and mind before flowing into the poses. Use props to support your practice, which builds up to the shoulderstand, Halasana.

programme.title: Handstands
programme.desc: Join Kino for 20 minutes of Handstand drills! Not recommended for beginners, this class does require a certain level of pre-established strength and flexibility. Work through these drills every week to take your handstand practice to the next level

programme.title: Healing and Happiness
programme.desc: Begin practice with a few minutes of mindfulness, feeling the breath and sensation in the body as a way of cultivating inward focus. Shift into a contemplative state, settling the mind below the frequency of thought. Learn to label inner processes in a way that will help you understand the nature of thought and emotion. As the quality of your awareness shifts deeper, Kino will skillfully guide you into a state of contemplation. This practice will help you process emotion and move towards healing and happiness.

programme.title: Health
programme.desc: Tune into the breath as an entry way to the present moment. Use this awareness to call your energy back into yourself and cultivate an increasing sense of wellbeing. Feel the sensation of the body and practice acceptance of whatever pleasant or unpleasantness arises. Focus the mind and notice the quality and texture of your thoughts and emotions. Once you settle into practice turn your awareness more fully to the inner experience, planting the seeds of happiness and wellbeing.

programme.title: Hips - Love
programme.desc: The journey of awakening the hips is very much a journey of self-love and self-discovery. Join Kino for a 30-minute practice that’s all about learning to love your hips. Avoid the temptation to judge and manipulate or force your flexibility by training the mind to be present amidst what may be the murky territory of the inner body around the hips.

programme.title: Hour Glass
programme.desc: In this episode of Kino’s Closet, Kino talks about her favorite brand of makeup from a company called Hour Glass. This is an American, luxury makeup brand that makes professional grade products that last. Check out this episode to see what Kino has to say about these products plus, get a simple review from professional makeup artist, Nanda Quero.

programme.title: Invert - Awaken
programme.desc: Join Kino for a class that’s all about inversions and the mindset of awakening. This 30-minute practice invites you to seize the opportunity to remain present and awake in the challenge of the practice. Begin the journey of turning yourself upside down to awaken the sleeper within.

programme.title: Janu Sirsasana A
programme.desc: This class is accessible to all, incorporates yoga fundamentals and builds up to Janu Sirsasana A.

programme.title: Leaning into Forward Folds
programme.desc: This session is all about sitting with the hamstrings and forward bends in a state of equanimity. Join Kino as she leads you on a journey to healing. Learn to sit with your discomfort and begin to uncover and understand the intelligent messages that come from within. 25 minutes

programme.title: Lolasana
programme.desc: This flow uses a chair supported sun salutation to get you started then flows through standing poses before finishing up with some accessible work in the arm balance Lolasana

programme.title: Love Your Body
programme.desc: Come back into alignment through awareness of the body. Use the breath as an anchor to cultivate present moment awareness. Redirect the attention from the external world to the inner world, beginning with the sensation of breath along the inside of the nostrils. Learn to feel what is rather than generating a story. Allow yourself to feel safe and loved through the practice of mindfulness.

programme.title: Love's Timeline
programme.desc: Join Kino for a 20 minute meditation that will guide you towards a sense of wholeness and connection to faith. Settle the attention on subtle sensations of breath moving in and out of the body and allow this to coax the mind into calming down. Observe the present moment, from a place of receptivity and embodiment, becoming love and stepping into unity with the heartbeat of the universe.

programme.title: Marichasana A
programme.desc: Tune in to the inner experience in this short flow that details a healthy use of breath and body in your yoga practice. This class builds up to Marichasana A.

programme.title: Marichasana C
programme.desc: Learn the fundamentals of yoga in this short, meditative practice that builds up to the twisting pose, Marichasana C.

programme.title: Material relationships
programme.desc: Start your meditation practice with a few moments of mindful awareness built around the movement of the breath and the sensations of the body. Cultivate equanimity as you notice the rise and fall of physical and emotional feelings. Let Kino help you drop down beneath the frequency of thought, where you can get in touch with your innate wholeness. Work with understanding your natural completeness, as you explore concepts of attachment and aversion. Find yourself in alignment with faith, breaking the inertia of limiting beliefs and thoughts. Practice towards a state of non attachment, a fertile ground in which to plant the seeds of a happier, more peaceful life.

programme.title: Natural Beauty
programme.desc: Ready to take your veganism to the next level? This episode of Kino’s Closet is all about Makeup! Tune in as Kino tries a new brand of vegan makeup with help from her makeup artist, Nanda Quero. In this episode, you’ll find out, not only why it’s important to choose ethically sourced brands, but also whether or not Kino gives this brand a thumbs up.

programme.title: Navasana
programme.desc: Come practice an accessible, energizing flow that incorporates yoga basics and builds up to Navasna, the boat pose.

programme.title: Obstacles
programme.desc: True faith is a valuable ally when facing obstacles. Begin practice with a few minutes of mindfulness, focusing on the natural, unopposed quality of the breath. Become aware of the sensations in the body. Learn to accept thought as thought and emotion as emotion. Practice equanimity as challenge arises, settling into the calm and equanimous mind.

programme.title: Opening the Hips
programme.desc: Join Kino for some yoga drills that will help you work on opening the hips with some external hip rotation. With this video, you will gain a greater understanding of the movement mechanics involved in the action of external hip rotation. Build strength in all the muscles that are involved in opening the hips through this 40-minute practice.

programme.title: Parsvakonasana
programme.desc: Join Kino for a chair yoga class that builds up to Parsvakonasana, the extended side angle pose.

programme.title: Parsvottanasana
programme.desc: This 20 minute practice starts with the basics, building a connection to breath and body. Flow through standing poses that build up to a prop supported variation of Parsvottanasana.

programme.title: Paschimottanasana
programme.desc: Begin with awareness of breath and body sensation in this gentle yoga class. You will find yourself present and relaxed by the end of this forward folding focused sequence.

programme.title: Personal Relationships
programme.desc: Join Kino for a 20 minute meditation on love and tuning into the flow of love in personal relationships. Begin your practice of mindful awareness by feeling the breath. Allow the breath to become an anchor that redirects the mind to the inner experience. Check in with the physical body and the sensations arising there and filtering into awareness. Tap into the energy of the heart and the love that flows there, allow this feeling to spread to all beings and yourself.

programme.title: Pigeon
programme.desc: Come explore supported hip opening with Kino. This class incorporates yoga fundamentals and builds up to Pigeon Pose.

programme.title: Plank
programme.desc: Join Kino for a short, gentle practice that is centered around core engagement and the plank pose

programme.title: Plank
programme.desc: Join Kino for one of her favorite daily yoga drills, plank! Kino takes you through a quick warm up before diving into the challenging world of plank pose. Get ready to tone your core and strengthen your shoulders!

programme.title: Positive Reinforcement
programme.desc: Join Kino for a focus on calm and equanimity as your meditation begins today. Bring your attention to the quality of the breath and let this awareness be a bridge into the field of presence. From this place learn to listen for inner guidance and to be receptive to signs that you're on the right path. Anchor yourself in your own inner goodness and let this be a powerful positive reinforcement in your life.

programme.title: Prasarita Padottanasana
programme.desc: A relaxing practice that utilizes props to both get you stronger and allow you to relax more. This class flows through standing poses and focuses on the forward fold called Prasarita Padottanasana.

programme.title: Purvottanasana
programme.desc: Cultivate a mindful state as you prepare for practice, feeling into the breath and body. Flow through a prop supported sequence that builds up to Purvottanasana.

programme.title: Reclined Twist
programme.desc: A relaxing practice that incorporates the fundamentals of yoga and has a focus on reclining twists.

programme.title: Seated Position for Meditation
programme.desc: Find the meditation position, (legs crossed, seated in a chair or laying down) that is accessible for you.

programme.title: Shalabhasana
programme.desc: A flow that thoroughly warms up the spine and builds up to the laying backbend called Shalabhasana.

programme.title: Shoulders
programme.desc: Build power and foundation with Kino as you join her for more Yoga Drills. This is perfect for those who are looking to build strength and learn strength building techniques. It's a great practice for those who are interested in becoming stronger both inside and out. Get ready to sweat and have some fun!

programme.title: Side Plank
programme.desc: Begin this gentle flow with a few moments of mindfulness, then explore the basics of yoga as we build up to a supported practice of side plank

programme.title: Sirsasana
programme.desc: A gentle flow that includes yoga fundamentals and builds up to sirsasana, the headstand.

programme.title: The Pelvic Floor - Forgive
programme.desc: The journey of yoga is a journey of deep intimacy with the body. In this class you will begin to explore the pelvic floor and the concept of forgiveness. Allow the natural intelligence of the inner body to shine cultivate of deep awareness of the intimate, inner space of the body in this 30 minute practice.

programme.title: Tree Pose
programme.desc: A practice that builds up to tree pose. Get rooted into the fundamentals of yoga practice including breath and balance.

programme.title: Trikonasana
programme.desc: Tune in to the quality of the breath and how the body is feeling as you begin this gentle all levels class. Flow through movements that will warm up the body and prepare you for Trikonasana, the triangle pose.

programme.title: Twist - The Heart - Feel
programme.desc: The final class in this series is all about feeling into and entering the heart space through the vehicle of twists. The unfelt body is a reservoir of the unlived life. Unlock your potential for healing by connecting with these deep inner spaces of the body and just feeling.

programme.title: Upward Facing Dog
programme.desc: A restorative flow that stretches and warms the body with a prop assisted sequence. This class has a focus on the fundamental pose Upward Facing Dog.

programme.title: Documentary - Abandoned Dreams
programme.desc: The abandoned boat dilemma is one of the most frustrating and alarming issues facing British Columbia's coastal communities. Reaching the end of their life cycle, with limited disposal options and almost no way to track ownership, hundreds of old boats are being left to rot, and sink or drift onto beaches and shorelines around our province. The result is a province-wide problem that affects coastal navigation, tourism and the environment. Abandoned Dreams looks into the root causes of this derelict boat epidemic and the future plans for safe boat disposal and recycling in BC.

Event Rider Masters - Lignieres
programme.desc: France is the host country for the Event Rider Masters 2019 Finale. The eventing competition concludes in Lingnières en Berry, at the Pöle du Cheval et de l'Àne venue. This area is unique for its romantic cities and villages surrounded by abundant countryside, hills and woodlands. Relive the most exciting moments of the 2019 finale at Lignieres.

programme.title: Dressage Season Review - Review
programme.desc: The Grand Prix at the final in Gothenburg will be disputed with Freestyle with music, and it will be extremely difficult. Only the best riders of the four leagues have made it this far and they have been giving their all throughout the entire season. Relive the best moments of the 2018/2019 Dressage World Cup season.

programme.title: Dubai Polo Gold Cup - Final
programme.desc: The world's best polo teams meet at the Dubai Polo Gold Cup competition. After days of competition, UAE and AM are the two lasting teams who will dispute the most important Polo tournament in Asia and the Middle East. They will have to show a combination of equestrian pursuits, skills and team effort to win. Relive the 2020 final between UAE vs. AM.

programme.title: Campus Life Experience - Episode 5
programme.desc: So far in Campus Life Experience we have strengthened our knowledge on the connection and relationship between horse and rider. However, participants are realizing their experience is almost over and emotions arise.

programme.title: Jumping International de Dinard - Grand Prix
programme.desc: The acclaimed CSI5* Grand Prix de la Ville de Dinard is, together with the Derby, one of the top events of the Jumping International de Dinard. programme.title: Copa Lazio
programme.desc: The Lazio Cup is a two-heat category on four courses of different heights: 115, 120, 125 and 140. With 17 teams at the start, it is an awaited event in the show jumping Italian agenda. Celebrated in "La Macchiarella" Equestrian Village, covering an area of 9 hectares, we can see riders, horses, ponies and spectators assemble to watch this exciting competition. Enjoy the best moments of the 2021 Lazio Cup!

The time needed to organize the event was very limited due to changes in organization, but the will and compromise of all organisers saw outstanding performances from the Italian cowboy dressage riders. We participate in the event and interview both organizers and participants to grasp their overall impressions.

programme.title: Longines FEI Nations Cup - 2019 La Baule Competition

programme.title: Horse Academy Pro - Chapter 3
programme.desc: The final episode of this season has arrived, and so has the competition. Riders will face each other in the saddle as they complete a jumping ground. Come enjoy with us!

programme.title: Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup - Abu Dhabi
CSI-W 5* La Coruna Longines Trophy - Longines Trophy

Who will end up in the podium?Watch the 2019 season on Horse TV.

programme.title: FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 1: Minding, Mentoring & Mountain Magic

Find out now in the final leg of the FEI Eventing Nations Cup 2021.

programme.desc: Two Ming patriots spend their days helping the weak and rescuing damsels in distress. This alum gets them in trouble, though, as they are captured and then volunteered to go after the fearsome Dragon Gang, a tribe of bandits that have been terrorizing the land.

programme.desc: Chow, on a visit to Thailand meets a girl who takes him around to see the sites. What he's really interested in is Thai boxing, so she brings him to a match where her friend is competing.

programme.title: The Black Dragon's Revenge
programme.desc: Three rival gangs embark on a search for Bruce Lee's handwritten "finger fighting " manual.

programme.title: Death Machines
programme.desc: An evil Oriental Dragon Lady injects three martial arts fighters with a serum that turns them into zombie-like assassins, and she sends them out against her enemies.

programme.title: Dragon Fist
programme.desc: Tong Huo-wan (Jackie Chan) seeks redress from the man responsible for his master's death, but becomes entangled in a feud between a local clan and gangsters.

programme.title: Kill Point
programme.desc: An L.A. cop investigating the rape and murder of his wife traces the crime to a psycho biker gang that smuggles guns. He teams up with an FBI agent to stop them and catch his wife's killers.

programme.title: Nine Death of the Ninja
programme.desc: A young martial artist-in-training named Tiger (Lou) is being stalked by Evil Ninja.

programme.title: The Black Draguon
programme.desc: Decent, simple, honest Chinese farmhand and ace martial artist Tai-Lin travels to the Philippines seeking his fortune. He gets a job as a dock worker and then discovers that his employers are involved in a crime syndicate that smuggles opium.

programme.title: The Doll Squad
programme.desc: Squad of beautiful government agents tries to catch saboteurs.

programme.title: Eros Una Vez María
programme.desc: María es el gran amor de Tonatiuh, pero él la pierde. Intenta mantener su esencia, buscando incansablemente en cada mujer que conoce, tratando de obtener tantas experiencias sobre ellas como pueda, para poder encontrar algo que le recuerde a su amor perdido. Todas esas mujeres tienen una particularidad: se llaman María.

programme.title: Choele
programme.desc: Todo ocurre en el pueblo de Choele Choel, provincia de Río Negro. Un niño y su padre intentan seguir juntos todo el verano, pero el chico ya decidió partir hacia otro lugar con su madre, cuando ésta llegue y le recoja. A la zona donde viven llega una chica, por la que comienzan a competir padre e hijo.

programme.title: El Campeón
programme.desc: LA HISTORIA DE UNA PROMESA DEL BOXEO, SU ENTRENADOR SOLO LO USA PARA BENEFICIO PROPIO. LA FAMA Y EL DINERO SOLO LE TRAE PROBLEMAS, ADEMAS QUE SUFAMILIA SE APROVECHA DE EL.

programme.title: Dos Abrazos
programme.desc: Cuatro personas que se ven forzadas a defenderse ante la vida, un ensimismado chico de doce años, la cajera que tiene un encuentro con él, un airado conductor de taxi y la enajenada hija de uno de sus pasajeros, se reúnen en dos abrazos.

programme.title: El Ultimo Verano
programme.desc: Carlos es un Profesor de universidad a punto de jubilarse, pero su futuro se ve en peligro porque una de sus alumnas lo acusa de haber sido acosada. Esto es solo el inicio de la peor racha de su vida ya que Carlos descubre que su esposa lo engaña y que la vida que el creía perfecta se esfuma poco a poco de sus manos... tal vez sea el ultimo verano en la vida de Carlos

programme.title: Espacio Interior
programme.desc: Lázaro permanece secuestrado en un cuarto de tres metros cuadrados completamente aislado del mundo exterior. Obligado a revelar información íntima sobre sus familiares, cae en una desidia total. Al borde de la muerte, se da cuenta, esperanzado, de que su voluntad y su mente nunca podrán ser secuestrados. Es posible que jamás lo liberen, pero su gran fe y dignidad le muestran la inquebrantable naturaleza del espíritu humano.

programme.title: El Deseo de Domingo
programme.desc: Narra la historia de Domingo, un adulto mayor que sufre Alzheimer y pasa sus días en un geriátrico en la ciudad de Viedma, desde donde intenta, a toda costa, viajar a la Capital, a San Isidro, a ver el gran premio de turf Carlos Pellegrini. Pero claro, no se trata de cualquier premio, sino el del año 1952. Para eso necesitará de la ayuda de Marcelo, su nieto, quien se encuentra en el dilema de conformarse con su puesto en una dependencia pública o seguir luchando por triunfar con su banda de rock. …

programme.title: Cuando Yo Te Vuelva a Ver
programme.desc: Treinta años después de haberse radicado en España, Paco regresa a la Argentina para apadrinar la boda de un amigo. Retirado y separado de su esposa española, se reencuentra con sus afectos. Como siempre, en los últimos treinta años, Margarita, ya jubilada como docente, arrastra hacia adelante su vida. En la fiesta de casamiento, Paco como padrino y Margarita como encargada del servicio de catering, se cruzan nuevamente aunque sin encontrarse, hasta que él la descubre en un video de la fiesta. El amor truncado por la ausencia y la negativa de ella a responder sus cartas, vuelve a renacer en una búsqueda por recuperar el tiempo perdido.

programme.title: Bruma
programme.desc: Martina se siente atrapada en una vida encasillada en la Ciudad de México. Al enterarse de su embarazo y sin saber qué hacer al respecto, decide ir a Berlín en busca del padre, e inicia un viaje donde encontrará su propia identidad.

programme.title: El Ultimo Fin de Semana
programme.desc: Diana quiere celebrar su próximo ascenso. Invita a la casa de su abuela a sus compañeros de trabajo, para pasar el fin de semana “perfecto”. Pero el pueblo esconde un gran secreto. Se dedican a pasar tres días de fiesta, sol, playa y alcohol. Aflorarán rencores, confesiones, deseo sexual, celos, tensiones… pero no están solos como creen y puede que, para más de uno, éste sea su último fin de semana

Corre el año 2097 que después de 30 años de paz y prosperidad se ha erradicado la letal pandemia del virus del 2067.Pero una sombra se cierne sobre las comunidades de supervivientes. Un espectro que vuelve para atormentar a aquellos que desterraron la causa de la pandemia logrando retornar a la supervivencia necesaria para sobrevivir a pesar de la lección sufrida por la humanidad desde el 2067

programme.title: Faraday
programme.desc: Faraday es un telépata especialista en fenómenos paranormales. Su novia, Pati, es una bloguera entregada a los cupcakes cuya máxima aspiración en la vida es ser famosa en internet. Alquilan un piso muy barato en el que al fin podrán independizarse, pero una vez instalados descubren que está encantado. “Faraday” es una historia de amor que supera todas las fronteras, incluidas las del Más Allá. Una comedia paranormal que tocará la fibra a todos aquellos que alguna vez han deseado ser “modernos”

programme.title: Club Habana
programme.desc: Bárbara es una estudiante de Artes Plásticas, que viajará a España para presentar una exposición de pinturas. Camino a una fiesta de despedida, le sorprende una tormenta y tiene que refugiarse en un viejo y decadente club nocturno al que asisten personas con intereses muy diversos y, en ocasiones, opuestos.

programme.title: Cartero
programme.desc: Hernán Sosa es un joven tímido que viene del interior a la ciudad. En su pueblo siempre estuvo enamorado de una chica inalcanzable, Yanina. Hernán consigue trabajo en el correo. Durante el reparto, Hernán descubre que Yanina se encuentra en la ciudad, en la zona de su reparto. En consecuencia, comienza a desplegar sus nuevos conocimientos de cartero para llegar hasta ella. Pero a medida que se acerca, descubre que unos viejos carteros están organizando un robo en el mismo edificio donde trabaja Yanina. Envalentonado por la fuerza del amor, Hernán se enfrentará a los peligros que rodean a Yanina para llegar a declararle lo que siente.

programme.title: Despertar El Polvo
programme.desc: Es la historia de un hombre que ha sufrido las desgracias de vivir una vida trasgredida por la delincuencia y corrupción, el barrio de Iztapalapa es el escenario donde vaga por las calles, invisible, ignorado y solitario, sumido en su miseria. Un evento desafortunado mueve el instinto protector de Chano que intenta regresar al mundo del crimen para lograr sacar a su ahijado de la cárcel.

programme.title: En Un Lugar De La Mancha
programme.desc: En una pequeña localidad de La Mancha, Isabel y Silvia, cansadas de esconder su pasión, deciden marcharse un fin de semana a la casa rural que alquila el sacerdote de un pueblo cercano. Pronto lamentarán su decisión.

programme.title: Día 13
programme.desc: Colton está enamorado de su nueva vecina Heather, pero teme que su padre adoptivo sea parte de un culto satánico. Él trata de protegerla y descubre que la verdad es más horrible.

programme.title: Cut Her Out
programme.desc: Darcy no puede purgar su mente de los abusos animales que sufrió de niña a manos de su madre. Ryan, el terapeuta de Darcy, descubre que la granja de su familia ha sido abandonada.

programme.title: Girl Gets Girl
programme.desc: Basada en la exitosa serie web española «Chica busca chica», Inés vive una vida encantadora con su bella novia. Todo su mundo se pone patas arriba cuando pierde un plazo de entrega por estar demasiado ocupada seduciendo a todas las mujeres atractivas con las que se cruza. Sin trabajo, sin dinero y sin novia, Inés se enfrenta a una existencia desconocida en un día de locura.

programme.title: Visiones Mortales [Scalper]
programme.desc: Todos a su alrededor, la psíquica Clementine Carter, están siendo brutalmente asesinados por un asesino enmascarado apodado "El Escalpador". ¿Es el psicópata muerto Andrew Lubitz vuelto de la tumba, un asesino imitador o un horror más allá de la imaginación? Clementine debe usar su segundo sentido para mantenerse un paso adelante de la cuchilla del maníaco y resolver el misterio.

programme.title: Until You Untie Me
programme.desc: Una joven bailarina se sume en una desesperación emocional tras perder a su familia en un accidente mortal. Su camino de autodestrucción se enreda con un médico infame por mala praxis. Su encuentro desemboca en una febril historia de amor que explora el fetichismo, el sadomasoquismo y el bondage.

programme.title: Sadomaster
programme.desc: La violencia urbana extrema reina en Argentina. El senador Beccar Varela se alza como la única forma de frenar la violencia con su política de «tolerancia cero». La gente no sospecha que Beccar es el jefe de la banda nazi que provoca la violencia. Cuando los miembros de la banda torturan y violan a un retrasado, un misterioso vengador enmascarado comienza su brutal venganza contra las bandas y los políticos corruptos.

programme.title: Many Pieces of Something
programme.desc: En medio de la jungla sexual de un festival de música en España, un grupo de jóvenes intenta alcanzar sus sueños.

programme.title: El Coro
programme.desc: El célebre y exigente director de uno de los mejores coros infantiles del mundo descubre un extraordinario talento en un niño huérfano conflictivo. Sus estrictas pero inspiradoras lecciones despertarán en el joven el amor por la música.

programme.title: Niño Perdido [Lost Child]
programme.desc: Una veterana del ejército regresa a su hogar y se encuentra con un niño perdido en el bosque. Mientras trata de buscar la identidad del chico, ella descubre un mundo de folklore y mentiras.

programme.title: Dirty Conscience
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes reclutas de la policía chilena son asignados a un duro y condecorado oficial para entrenarlos. Pronto queda claro que su nuevo jefe está implicado en graves casos de corrupción. Al principio, los dos jóvenes policías intentan hacer la vista gorda. Pero cuando su jefe empieza a dudar de su lealtad, los dos reclutas deben elegir entre salvar su honor y su carrera, antes de que su jefe los mate.

programme.title: All the Fires
programme.desc: A pyromaniac teenager sets off on a journey in search of a girl he met online and to confront his sexuality, while leaving behind all his fires.

programme.title: A Haunting In Ravenwood
programme.desc: Una pareja de recién casados llega a la casa de la difunta esposa del esposo, donde se han mantenido flores en memoria de la mujer fallecida. Pronto, sucesos inquietantes llevan a la nueva esposa a creer que está perdiendo la razón.

programme.title: Restoration
programme.desc: Un hombre de 50 años se queda sin medios para mantener su estilo de vida basado en el placer y trama un plan muy cuestionable para vender la casa histórica de su madre sin que ella lo sepa. Para que no se entere, construye una réplica del dormitorio de su madre y le dice que la casa está prohibida mientras se restaura para devolverle su antiguo esplendor. Sorprendentemente, es el inevitable fracaso de su cruel y escandalosa ilusión lo que podría darle la oportunidad de restaurar su propia humanidad.

programme.title: Wedding In New York
programme.desc: En España, la madre de Carlos le pide que les represente en una boda familiar en Nueva Jersey. Él acepta encantado la invitación, pero con un pícaro plan en mente: Convencerá a su buen amigo Gonzalo para que ocupe su lugar en la boda familiar y así poder visitar en secreto a su antiguo amor. Una serie de coincidencias se convertirán en grandes complicaciones cuando los dos amigos se encuentren enamorados de la futura novia y de la amante del novio.

programme.title: El Demonio del Sueño [Conjuring the Beyond]
programme.desc: Un estudio del sueño se torna oscuro cuando los participantes comienzan a desaparecer. ¿Acaso es todo parte de su imaginación o hay algo demoníaco detrás del asunto?

programme.title: Prosthesis
programme.desc: Un artista de prótesis con un pasado traumático encuentra un cadáver en su laboratorio. Mientras decide qué hacer con el cuerpo, tendrá que hacer malabarismos con su extraña vida familiar, la posibilidad de un nuevo amor, crear la prótesis perfecta para un cliente muy especial, todo ello en medio del rodaje local de una película de zombis.

programme.title: Masacre En El Bosque [Pillow Party Massacre]
programme.desc: Perseguidos por una broma que terminó en una tragedia, cinco amigos se reúnen para sanar sus heridas. Pero no todos son capaces de olvidar, y está claro que alguien, o algo, está buscando vengarse.

programme.title: Accidental Blessing
programme.desc: Beatriz, una psicóloga fracasada, huye a la casa de su infancia para escapar de los cargos de fraude, sólo para descubrir que su extravagante tía ha convertido la finca en un instituto. Lo que al principio parece una terrible sorpresa, en realidad la ayudará a encontrar por fin un camino satisfactorio en la vida como profesora de teatro poco convencional.

programme.title: 50 Chuseok
programme.desc: La realización de un video por el medio siglo de la comunidad coreana en Argentina lleva al actor Chang Sung Kim de regreso a su tierra natal. Pero pronto el viaje deviene en un inesperado y transformador reencuentro con su familia y la cultura.

programme.title: Acapulco Sunset
programme.desc: Mexico’s top criminologist, Mateo Osorio is dispatched to the ultra-chic resort city of Acapulco to solve a series of seemingly unconnected homicides in this 1980 set crime thriller.

programme.title: Dinastia Vivanco Movie
programme.desc: Devolver al vino lo que el vino nos a dado: Directed by Zev Robinson. Pedro Vivanco started off delivering his family's wine door-to-door ...

programme.title: Locos Por Madonna
programme.desc: A biography of a universal icon of music and Hollywood, Madonna, better known as the Queen of Pop. Sabbatical Entertainment celebrates Madonna's illustrious career spanning more than four decades, always pushing the boundaries of entertainment. Not afraid of controversy, the Material girl, through her talents, redefined pop culture history.

programme.title: La Granja del Horror [Pig Killer]
programme.desc: Basado en la aterradora historia real de Robert 'Willy' Pickton, el granjero de cerdos que se convirtió en un prolífico asesino en serie, cuyos horribles crímenes conmocionaron al mundo.

programme.title: A Place In The Caribbean
programme.desc: El romance está en el aire en la pintoresca isla caribeña de Roatán, pero los turbulentos pasados de sus huéspedes amenazan con domar sus deseos.

programme.title: Fanny y Alexander
programme.desc: Suecia, principios del siglo XX. Fanny y Alexander son dos hermanos de ocho y diez años, respectivamente, que pertenecen a una familia dedicada al teatro. Al morir su padre, la madre se casa con un pastor protestante y el ambiente cálido y familiar del que disfrutaban cambia radicalmente. El pastor es un hombre severo, inflexible y posesivo que impone a todos una disciplina cruel.

programme.title: One in a Thousand
programme.desc: Iris ha sido expulsada del colegio y pasa los días con sus primos. Cuando conoce a Renata, queda fascinada, y pronto empiezan a flirtear a pesar de los crecientes rumores sobre el pasado de Renata.

programme.title: I'm Ringo
programme.desc: El boxeador argentino Oscar Natalio Bonavena, conocido popularmente como Ringo, fue asesinado en la puerta de un burdel de Nevada, Reno, en Estados Unidos, en 1976. Ringo, que había peleado con Muhammad Ali, nunca había perdido la esperanza de tener la oportunidad de una revancha con el boxeador estadounidense.

programme.title: Death Of A Ghost Hunter
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, un cazador de fantasmas, Carter Simms, recibe un pago para llevar a cabo una investigación paranormal de una supuesta casa encantada. Junto con un cámara, un reportero y un defensor espiritual, se embarca en un viaje de tres noches hacia el terror.

programme.title: Los Girasoles
programme.desc: Giovanna y Antonio, dos jóvenes napolitanos, se casan doce días antes del comienzo de la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Unos años más tarde, Antonio es dado por desaparecido en el frente ruso pero su esposa se niega a olvidarle. Armada con una fotografía de su amado, Giovanna viaja incansablemente por Rusia para encontrarle cueste lo que cueste.

programme.title: Grey Eyes
programme.desc: En un futuro postapocalíptico, la humanidad es daltónica. Un brillante científico muere repentinamente, dejando su preciado maletín -lleno de una droga sintética altamente adictiva que permite a la gente volver a ver los colores- a Ana, una niña de 12 años. La posesión del maletín la convierte en el objetivo de un doctor con malvados planes para la droga, y su única esperanza de escapar de su persecución depende de la ayuda de los dos devotos guardaespaldas del científico muerto. Juntos, su épico y peligroso viaje gira en torno a un tremendo secreto: la propia Ana podría ser la clave para salvar un mundo en ruinas.

programme.title: Kruel
programme.desc: Kruel es un largometraje de terror/thriller sobre un asesino psicótico que se hace pasar por heladero para acercarse a los objetos de su afecto.

programme.title: 7 Cajas
programme.desc: Víctor recibe una insólita propuesta, transportar 7 cajas de contenido desconocido por el Mercado Número 4 pero las cosas se complican por el camino.

programme.title: Side-B
programme.desc: Wang Li-Sheng ha conocido a una chica española en Internet y ha decidido dejarlo todo y vivir su historia de amor en España. Las cosas no salen como él esperaba y acaba sin novia, sin dinero y sin pasaporte, por lo que tiene que buscarse la vida como inmigrante ilegal en un país del que no sabe nada. Su suerte cambiará cuando conozca a Marisa, una soñadora de sangre caliente que ha encontrado su lugar en este país; y a Mioara, una chica de Bucarest que llegó hace dos años buscando trabajo. Como suele ocurrir cuando somos jóvenes y las cosas suceden demasiado deprisa, sus corazones llevarán a estos desconocidos de los árboles por caminos no demasiado rectos.

programme.title: Las Puertas del Infierno [Insidious Inferno]
programme.desc: Una cabaña aislada está plagada de una serie de horribles asesinatos, sin que los habitantes lo sepan, algo de otro mundo acecha dentro de los pasillos.

programme.title: Maid
programme.desc: Cuando su señora contrata a otra sirvienta para que la ayude en las tareas domésticas, una criada amargada e introvertida causa estragos en la casa.

programme.title: Exorcismo En El Vientre [Exorcism in Utero]
programme.desc: Una mujer embarazada debe encontrar la forma de salvarse a sí misma y a su bebé después de encontrar un poderoso anillo que la posee cuando se lo prueba.

programme.title: Eva + Candela
programme.desc: La ambición profesional de dos mujeres fuertes e independientes las une, pero también es lo que finalmente las separa, mientras somos testigos de cómo su intenso amor se metamorfosea en medio de etapas de enamoramiento, sensualidad, amor, comodidad y, finalmente, rutina.

programme.title: Día 13
programme.desc: Colton está enamorado de su nueva vecina Heather, pero teme que su padre adoptivo sea parte de un culto satánico. Él trata de protegerla y descubre que la verdad es más horrible.

Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it!

Camila, tells Mother Isabel of her sadness for not having met her mother, not even in pictures. She communicates with her cousin Henry and he informs her of an address which she decides to attend and also Max goes to a strange call. Elda, who receives flowers from Alfredo, fears that Luciano will discover her.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fernando threatens Jeli with taking the child, but Leandro warns him that he is his father. Fausto waits for his son Gregorio, beats him, throws him out of the house and decides to take all his belongings and benefits. Ezequiel chooses to lock up Julia; Gregorio comes to take his wife, Celso finds them, enraged and drugged, and attacks them, wounding the young woman.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Celso, unhinged, watches and mocks Fausto, who shoots at his lover's chest, who falls instantly. Fausto goes to his office, telling everyone that nothing happened. Camila, at the scene, tries to convince Patricia to flee because everything indicates that she is Celso's murderer.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Patricia, crying, denies having killed Celso. Fausto manipulates the children into believing that their mother is the killer and must turn herself in. Camila eloquently presents her version of events and then tells Ezequiel that he lied to make Patricia pay for a crime she didn't commit, just like they did with their mother.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila, in order to make Patricia live the same anguish that her mother must have felt, will offer her help and then expose her publicly. Camila has the recorded video of what happened with Celso and the condition for not handing it over to the police is that Fausto tells how his mother was incriminated.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila offers Patricia to hand over the video, only if she betrays Fausto and gives it to the police. Patricia tells Camila that her mother was not such a saint and that she was the cause of this war between the families, because of her relationship with two men at the same time. Fausto hires Anton again to kill his wife.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto and Ezequiel confront each other; the video that projects Celso's death will sink Fausto unless he signs a confession where he clarifies that Rosa Blanco was unjustly condemned. Fausto manipulates saying that Ezequiel also confesses that he killed his brother Augusto, Camila's father. She arrives in time to stop Ezequiel from shooting Fausto.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto, narrates in detail what happened years ago. He lies blatantly, Torrealba thinks he wants to blame his wife for having been unfaithful to him. Camila reproaches Mother Isabel harshly. Rosa cannot appear because they want to kill her. Axel, disappointed because Amelia hid the paternity of his son from him.

programme.desc: Ezequiel in conflict with his children. Camila defends them and tells him that her children are afraid of him. Max is willing to meet Rosa, even at the risk of his life and Camila organizes a party to unmask Elda.

programme.title: Ashe interview
programme.desc: Ashe about growing up in a conservative bubble, moving across the country to pursue music, feeling liberated, her debut album Ashlyn Me Without You, a satirical songwriting approach, I’m Fine, Ryne’s Song, sharing her brother’s story, the impact music can have, knowing when an album is done, writing about her divorce, working with FINNEAS, what she’s working on now.

programme.title: Gary Numan interview
programme.desc: Gary about his new album Intruder, the success of Savage (Songs from a Broken World), feeling pressure, why Machine + Soul didn’t work, finding his way again, working through depression on Splinter (Songs From A Broken Mind), his creative daughters, the earliest songs he wrote, the brutal nature of the music business, climate change, putting your head in the sand, Saints And Liars, science vs religion, engaging his fans, his thoughts on artificial intelligence, new songs.

programme.title: The Drums
programme.desc: An Interview with The Drums

programme.title: John Petrucci interview
programme.desc: John about his continuing love for the guitar, looking at his own music objectively, challenging himself, working on Terminal Velocity, playing the blues, Out of the Blue, making a style your own, the song Terminal Velocity, relearning Gemini, playing with Dave LaRue and Mike Portnoy, his old drumkit, putting the album out on his own label, learning more about the business, the impact of Eddie van Halen.

programme.title: Animal Collective interview - Panda Bear
programme.desc: Noah about injuring his finger, how the Animal Collective got started, why he makes music, his creative process, the beginnings of Time Skiffs, working in service of the songs, shaping the arrangements, being guarded about lyrics, Prester John, Car Keys, a backwards album cycle, a crossroads for the music industry, naming the album ‘Time Skiffs'

programme.title: Big Thief interview - Adrienne Lenker
programme.desc: Adrianne about curiosity, a sense of stillness, creativity and songwriting, music as a bridge to the etherial world, tapping into inspiration, why we do what we do, starting on the new album U.F.O.F, dealing with success, keeping a connection with yourself as you evolve, wanting to be part of something bigger, how the band was formed, the album title, alienation in society, sharing her art.

programme.title: Death Angel interview - Ted Aguilar
programme.desc: Ted about being a Death Angel fan from day 1, coming up in the Bay Area trash scene, how he got into music, joining Death Angel, his first shows with the band, perseverance and the love for playing music, The Bastard Tracks, his favorite live tracks, rare live tracks, the challenges with Frolic Through the Park, acoustic songs, his thoughts on Rob and Mark’s lyrics, Tom Petty, working on a new Death Angel album, not being able to tour, adapting to a changing industry.

programme.title: Marlon Williams interview
programme.desc: Marlon about touring with Lorde, dabbling in acting, the start of My Boy, being judged publicly, eclectic songwriting, the song My Boy, simplicity in his writing, Māori strumming, Don’t Go Back, finding a healthy work/life balance, Thinking of Nina, Soft Boys Make The Grade

programme.title: David Paich interview
programme.desc: David about writing poems as a child, Elton John, Houston I’m Coming To See You, forming Toto, Hold The Line, Rosanna, track splicing and modern production, working on The Girl Is Mine, Forgotten Toys, Queen Charade, Forward, Willibelongtoyou, Spirit of the Moonrise, All The Tears That Shine

programme.title: Jinjer interview - Tatiana and Eugene
programme.desc: Tatiana and Eugene rising in popularity, releasing the new album Wallflowers, adjust to life without touring, music as escapism, the writing process, working on the sound of the new album, Tatiana needing pressure to write lyrics, being a live-oriented band, high-flowing poetry, improvising with vocals, personal lyrics, Copycat and authenticity in art, creating something of your own

programme.title: Tom Chaplin interview
programme.desc: Tom about climate change, a new attitude to living, parenthood and growing older, asking yourself the difficult questions, happiness not being a destination, not fitting in as a teenager and dealing with negative emotions, Stars Align and working with Ethan Johns, electronic sounds, Gonna Run, brutally honest lyrics, the road he has traveled, Overshoot

programme.title: Destroyer interview - Dan Bejar
programme.desc: Dan about film scores, when he became obsessed with songwriting, instrumental music, using the original vocal tapes, Crimson Tide, lyrics and sounds, The Television Music Supervisor, a collective process, Cue Synthesizer, his musical identity, figuring out how to play the record live, the title Have We Met.

programme.title: St. Vincent interview
programme.desc: Annie about how she started in music, creative expression, the sound of the early 70s, writing for her new album Daddy’s Home, writing about flawed people, Somebody Like Me, finding stillness for the first time, not worrying about the commercial side, signing an autograph in prison, why she decided to write about the incarceration of her father, the Wurlitzer, working with Jack Antonoff, the various ways of writing songs, knowing when a song is done, performing at SNL.

programme.title: Jean-Michel Jarre interview
programme.desc: Jean-Michel about Welcome To The Other Side, a virtual Notre Dame, the impact of the pandemic on music, innovations in music technology, binaural recording, VR and augmented reality as new forms of expression, the value of music, respecting intellectual property, this being only the beginning of the digital age, artificial intelligence, Ray Charles and Pierre Soulages, lessons from his mother, a street in Lyon being named after his mother

programme.title: Between The Buried And Me interview - Dustie Waring
programme.desc: Dustie about his mindset around the first Colors album, never repeating themselves, songs that are difficult to play, pushing themselves, working on Colors II during the pandemic, writing the album over the internet, a collective writing approach, believing in albums, being proud of what you create, preparing for live shows, art that takes risks, creative freedom, bands that last.

programme.title: Glass Animals interview - Joe Seaward
programme.desc: Joe about gearing up towards the third album Dreamland, suffering a terrible accident, a time for reflection, not taking things for granted, finding out who the people around you really are, the first rehearsal after the accident, the songwriting for Dreamland, Your Love, how he connects with all of the songs on the album, songs that make you feel, not being able to tour the album, finding new ways to present the album.

programme.title: DMA's interview - Tommy O'Dell
programme.desc: Tommy about their show at the Brixton Academy and Liam Gallagher, finding his voice, the album Glow, dance elements, writing lyrics, Silver, staying true to yourself, ambition, not trying to please everyone, Never Before, Criminals and pop, songs that evolve on the road, Life is a Game of Changing, what he learned as a frontman.

programme.title: Katie Melua interview
programme.desc: Katie about her new album No. 8, playing the entire album live, Remind Me To Forget, her first studio album without Mike Batt, changing things up, celebrating great musicianship, working with producer Leo Abrahams, developing as a songwriter, English Manner, her divorce, love propaganda, focusing on what’s important, being adventurous, getting into photography.

programme.title: Joe Satriani interview
programme.desc: Joe about when he was still a beginner on guitar, working hard to get better, NYC in the early 70s, the surrealness of his career, teaching Steve Vai, finding “work-arounds” as a guitar player, Eddie van Halen, The Elephants of Mars, experimentation, composing songs over the internet, songs coming together organically, a song inspired by Questlove, Randy Rhoads and what keeps inspiring him.

programme.title: Declan McKenna interview
programme.desc: Declan about political engagement, making people think, The Kids Don’t Wanna Come Home, confusion, younger generations, his first songs, rowdy live shows, winning over crowds, a sold-out tour, his upcoming debut record, growing as a songwriter

programme.title: DMA's interview - Johnny Took
programme.desc: Johnny about the past 2 years, their loyal fans, early influences and genre-blending, the evolution of their sound, having loads of time in the studio, shaping How Many Dreams?, I Don’t Need To Hide, creating a dynamic live show, old vs new songs, De Carle and pushing boundaries

programme.title: Band of Horses interview - Ben Bridwell
programme.desc: Ben about needing a change, taking a stab at producing the album, the sound of Things Are Great, making a connection, sounding more like himself, Warning Signs, having success, struggling during lockdown, his love for songwriting, being a conduit for songs, being a fan of music first, trusting himself.

programme.title: Myles Kennedy interview
programme.desc: Myles about a road trip through America, getting out of your bubble, his new solo album The Ides of March, slide guitar, the Sifting Through The Fire intro, making sense of the world and songwriting, Get Along, playing the blues, Love Rain Down, the title track, uncertainty about the future, affecting people with music, the need to create, and a lot more! (11/05/2021)

programme.title: Agnes Obel interview
programme.desc: Agnes about playing piano at an early age, starting to write her own songs, lyrics. and melodies, tapping into the stream of inspiration, a great sense of freedom, Myopia, Camera’s Rolling, playing with pitch, knowing when you’re on the right track, experimenting with her voice, vocals vs instrumentals

programme.title: Shaggy interview
programme.desc: Shaggy about his earliest Christmas memories, Raggamuffin Christmas, having good people around you, becoming a brand, why he got into music, welcoming change, always wanting to learn, how the Christmas In The Islands, album got started, Caribbean Christmas parties, the cultural impact of Jamaica, affecting people in a positive way, his favorite live act, what inspires his songwriting, music for the right mood, Bob Marley.

programme.title: SIXX:A.M. interview - James Michael
programme.desc: James about being an observer of life, memories of his childhood, music production back in the day, modern production techniques, the HITS album, maintaining a sense of innocence, living out his rock star dreams, dealing with public notoriety, all having their favorite SIXX:A.M. albums and songs, talking about substance abuse, the connection with their fans, the power and importance of music, music as comfort food, Bat Out Of Hell.

programme.title: Alain Clark interview
programme.desc: Alain over echte connecties maken, de iPad generatie, Sunday Afternoon, de afstand met z’n publiek verkleinen, Michael Jackson, een echo van Bad Therapy, schrijven wat hij voelt, samenwerkingen, kwetsbaarheid en eerlijkheid, Song’s Don’t Die, Joni Mitchell, mensen raken met z’n muziek, clubshows op zondagmiddag

programme.title: Gilbert O'Sullivan interview
programme.desc: Gilbert about performing live, why he started writing songs, The Beatles, the first song he was proud of, Alone Again (naturally), his creative process, the new album Driven and writing melodies, the art of songwriting, working with Mick Hucknall and KT Tunstall, keeping up with modern music, a misunderstood song, the drive to create

programme.title: Floor Jansen interview
programme.desc: Floor about developing her solo career, finding her own sound, her approach to songwriting, Fire, staying connected with her fans, showing her personality on social media, Tuomas’ writing and her own creative expression, working towards an album, new Nightwish songs, still growing as a vocalist, participating in ‘Sing Meinen Song’

programme.title: The Lumineers interview - Wesley Schultz and Jermiah Fraites
programme.desc: Wesley and Jeremiah about Cleopatra, something they learned from U2, how we connect to music, transcending generations, album III, opening up to others, taking the stigma away from addiction, difficult subjects, Gloria, Kurt Cobain, sadness and beauty, telling the truth about addiction, the identities of all their albums, how they see succes, playing the long game, what makes a good song.

programme.desc: Dave about music in the 60s, the language of counterculture, an amazing fuzz tone, how music is remembered, Hawkwind and bands that deserve more recognition, making a deal with the devil, the band Table Scraps, shaping the album Better Dystopia, art in the internet world, capturing the right sound, Jack White, learning about his voice, Dust’s Learning to Die, dealing with the lockdowns, live music in the 70s, talking vs listening, music as a transportive experience, commenting about society, how musicians get paid, hope for the future, the era of infotainment.

programme.title: Max Cavalera interview

programme.title: Fish interview
programme.desc: Fish about keeping busy during luckdown, working on the Weltschmerz album, Script for a Jester’s Tear saving his ass, growing vegetables, looking for silver linings, the global economy, the health services, climate change, where the idea for Weltschmerz came from, his character driven style of writing, mental health, Grace of God, his retirement from music, Marillion getting too big, knowing what he wants to make, taking his time, being tough on his own lyrics, leaving people wanting more, doing a double album, never having been financially motivated, doing exactly what you want.

programme.title: Walking on Cars interview - Patrick and Sorcha
programme.desc: Patrick and Sorcha about being back on the road, growing up around music, shaping ones identity, when Patrick started writing lyrics, feeling pressure for the second album Colours, Monster, a new energy, a deeper emotion, surprising each other, having matured a lot, being completely content with the album, a sense of relief, Coldest Water, having a positive attitude.

programme.title: Steve Vai interview
programme.desc: Steve about dealing with injuries, the start of Inviolate, his very first compositions, how you deal with adversity, Frank Zappa, depression in 20s, Flex-able, removing expectations, Knappsack, genuine inspiration, allowing your creative self to flourish, fantasy goals vs passion, being careful with your ego, getting in toch with your emotions, Avalancha, how he generally writes music, Sandman Cloud Mist, working on new techniques, working with the Metropole Orchestra, Eddie Van Halen.

programme.title: Charlotte Wessels interview
programme.desc: Charlotte about the release of Tales From Six Feet Under Vol. II, creating a setlist with solo material, creating a story with her solo work, songs written for the live show, making sure the songs work on stage, writing a song a month, allowing songs to evolve, Against All Odds, The Phantom Touch, Venus Rising, the struggle for equality, The Final Roadtrip, worries about the future, the musical direction she’s heading in, future plans

programme.desc: Beth about learning from gardening, magical moments, addressing personal issues, facing your problems and taking responsibility, singing Led Zeppelin songs, healing through music, recording vocals, Stairway To Heaven and No Quarter, getting honest feedback, other artists she would like to cover, writing new songs of her own, trying new things, being willing to fail and learn, her love for the Netherlands.

programme.title: Jerry Cantrell and Tyyler Bates interview
programme.desc: Jerry and Tyler about the John Wick 2 OST, the start of Brighten, their creative process together, using his time outside of Alice in Chains well, darkness and glimmers of hope, writing lyrics, letting the art speak for itself, having two drummers on the album, Greg Puciato’s harmonies, Travis’ thoughts on Alice in Chains, Jerry looking back at his early career, songs that defined the Alice in Chains sound.

programme.title: Eivør interview
programme.desc: Eivør about growing up in a secluded place, being close to nature, electronic and organic sounds, how she starts on a new album, the new album Segl, her creative force, opening up for collaborations, Only Love with Ásgeir, Let It Come, listening to your inner voice, contrasts, a crossroads in her life, creative freedom, the title Segl (sail), hope, Patience, making people feel something.

programme.title: Wardruna interview - Einar Selvik (2021)
programme.desc: Einar about hunting for songs, inspiration in nature, not wanting to repeat himself, the influence of Skald on the new record, building a strong foundation of knowledge, a multi-disciplinary approach, highlighting the things that universally resonate with people, learning from the past, the album Kvitravn, how he writes his songs, the title track, a flock of ravens around his house, letting a song be what it is, live performances, working on the Assassins Creed Valhalla game, how we remember history.

programme.title: Epica interview - Simone Simons
programme.desc: Simone about a forced sabbatical, what keeps her busy these days, the starting point of the new album Omega, writing together in the same room, finding the musical direction, revisiting Design Your Universe, The Skeleton Key, dreams and nightmares, fame vs privacy, Omega being a very diverse album, the Omega point, light vs darkness, Freedom – The Wolves Within, looking back at their earlier work, working with Ayreon on Transitus.

programme.desc: Zoltan about being forced to take a break, what drives him, living life to the fullest, manifesting thoughts, wanting to be an astronaut, getting started on AfterLife, the band being polarizing, success and envy, fresh energy in the band, true creative freedom, the concept of AfterLife, a cultural paradigm shift, near-death experiences, spirituality, Judgement Day.

programme.title: Daughtry interview - Chris Daughtry

programme.title: Alt-J interview - Thom Sonny Green

programme.desc: Steven about releasing an album during the pandemic, falling out of love with the guitar, the origins of his new album The Future Bites, living in an electronic world, Eddie van Halen, King Ghost, an exciting songwriting process, making the characters he writes about believable, creativity and technology, the internet changing human nature, the decline of truth and reality, positive change, the year 2032 an consumer culture, curiosity being under threat.

programme.title: Damien Jurado Interview
programme.desc: Damien about how his songs come to him, Bird Tricked Into The Tree, not overthinking music, an emphasis on his vocals, producing without friend Richard Swift, his inner voice, Ochoa, the album title What’s New, Tomboy?, the characters he writes about, artists vs entertainers, connecting through music, Oh Yeah by Bo Diddley.

programme.title: Bob Mould interview
programme.desc: Bob about his early fascination with music, songs he wrote when he was 9, discovering punk rock, The Ramones and Iggy Pop, forming Hüsker Dü, gaining attention, when the band fell apart, Workbook, his time in Sugar, his parents passing, moving to Berlin, writing for Sunshine Rock.

programme.title: Cindy Blackman interview
programme.desc: Cindy about The Quarantine Blues, a chance to reset, becoming better humans, her love for the drums, always looking to improve, singing a lot on the new album Give The Drummer Some, We Came To Play, Mother Earth, sharing music, bringing jazz to more people, not putting music into boxes, inspiration, the incredible jazz musicians she learned from, enjoying the little things.

programme.title: Countain Crows interview - Adam Duritz
programme.desc: Adam about visiting his friends farm in England, shaving his head, starting on the Butter Miracle EP, music being a personal thing for him, Tall Grass, the evolution of his songwriting, the ghosts from your childhood, learning how to live, a screw-up with the release, working on a second Butter Miracle suite, keeping true to the song, a trumpet solo, the album getting so much support, feeling responsible for his crew.

programme.title: Declan McKenna interview
programme.desc: Declan about his album Zeros, finding his place in music, playfulness, making observations about society, a positive sense of humanity, Daniel You’re Still a Child, The Social Dilemma documentary, turning off his notifications, the good and bad of social media, organic and raw sounds, good mistakes, capturing the right energy on the album, trusting yourself as a musician, taking control, finally getting the album out, his favorite lyric on the album.

programme.title: Sleaford Mods with jason Part 2
programme.desc: Jason about Teacher Faces Porn Charges, starting on the album English Tapas, current affairs, a hip hop influence, getting the working class tag, humor, self-reflection, Messy Anywhere, Andrew’s beats, getting critiqued, people’s opinions, the temperament of English people, Rough Trade, their music abroad, the live shows, genuine elation, having no pretense, professionalism

programme.title: Kevin Morby interview

programme.title: Eefje de Visser interview
